rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH healthy_genes AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    xg.gene_symbol,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM healthy_expression he
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xg
    ON he.ensembl_gene_id = xg.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE he.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
    AND he.ensembl_gene_id <> ''
    AND he.uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
    AND he.uberon_anatomical_id <> ''
),
de_genes AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid
  FROM differential_expression de
  WHERE de.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND de.gene_symbol <> ''
    AND de.doid IS NOT NULL
),
mutation_genes AS (
  -- map_protein_disease_mutation.ensembl_transcript_id holds transcript ids, but we can still try to join to xref_gene_ensembl by ensembl_gene_id when available.
  -- Keep identifiers so results remain joinable; only include non-null gene symbol / ensembl ids.
  SELECT
    x.gene_symbol,
    x.ensembl_gene_id
  FROM disease_mutation_tissue dmt
  JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON mp.ensembl_transcript_id IS NOT NULL
       -- we cannot reliably equate transcript id to gene id; include rows where the map has an ensembl_transcript_id and a linked ensembl_gene_id via xref (if any)
  LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x
    ON x.ensembl_gene_id = mp.ensembl_transcript_id
  WHERE dmt.uberon_anatomical_id IS NOT NULL
    AND dmt.uberon_anatomical_id <> ''
    AND dmt.uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%'
    AND (x.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL OR x.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL)
),
lung_uberons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue
  WHERE uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%'
),
lung_doids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM disease WHERE name ILIKE '%lung%'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT doid FROM cancer_tissue WHERE uberon_anatomical_id IN (SELECT uberon_anatomical_id FROM lung_uberons)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol, m.gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol,
  COALESCE(g.ensembl_gene_id, xref.ensembl_gene_id, m.ensembl_gene_id) AS ensembl_gene_id
FROM (
  -- healthy expression in lung anatomy
  SELECT gene_symbol, ensembl_gene_id FROM healthy_genes hg
  WHERE hg.uberon_anatomical_id IN (SELECT uberon_anatomical_id FROM lung_uberons)
) g
FULL JOIN (
  -- differential expression for lung DOIDs
  SELECT gene_symbol, NULL::character varying AS ensembl_gene_id FROM de_genes dg
  WHERE dg.doid IN (SELECT id FROM lung_doids)
) d
  ON g.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND d.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND g.gene_symbol = d.gene_symbol
FULL JOIN (
  -- mutation-associated genes in lung tissue
  SELECT gene_symbol, ensembl_gene_id FROM mutation_genes
) m
  ON COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol) IS NOT NULL
     AND m.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
     AND m.gene_symbol = COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- ensure we can surface an ensembl id when present from xref if missing above
  SELECT ensembl_gene_id FROM xref_gene_ensembl x2
  WHERE x2.gene_symbol = COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol, m.gene_symbol)
  LIMIT 1
) xref ON true
WHERE COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol, m.gene_symbol) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(g.gene_symbol, d.gene_symbol, m.gene_symbol) <> ''
ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_direction_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol,
    de.doid,
    de.log2fc,
    de.pvalue,
    de.adjpvalue,
    de.expression_change_direction,
    CASE
      WHEN de.expression_change_direction IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE 'up%' THEN true
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE '+%' THEN true
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE 'increas%' THEN true
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE 'down%' THEN false
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE '-%' THEN false
      WHEN LOWER(de.expression_change_direction) LIKE 'decreas%' THEN false
      ELSE NULL
    END AS is_upregulated,
    CASE
      WHEN de.statistical_significance IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN LOWER(de.statistical_significance) IN ('significant','sig','s','yes','true','y','1') THEN true
          WHEN LOWER(de.statistical_significance) IN ('not significant','notsignificant','ns','no','false','n','0') THEN false
          ELSE NULL
        END
      WHEN de.adjpvalue IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE WHEN de.adjpvalue < 0.05 THEN true ELSE false END
      WHEN de.pvalue IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE WHEN de.pvalue < 0.05 THEN true ELSE false END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS is_statistically_significant
  FROM differential_expression de
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.name
FROM differential_expression_direction_normalized der
JOIN disease d ON der.doid = d.id
WHERE der.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND der.is_upregulated = true
  AND der.is_statistically_significant = true
ORDER BY d.name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_row AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description,
    b.biomarker_id
  FROM biomarker b
),
-- find FDA tests info that include a doid (disease id)
biomarker_fda_tests_w_doid AS (
  SELECT
    bf.id AS biomarker_fda_id,
    bft.test_submission,
    bft.doid
  FROM biomarker_fda bf
  JOIN biomarker_fda_test bft
    ON bft.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
    AND bft.test_submission = bf.test_submission
  WHERE bft.doid IS NOT NULL
),
-- link biomarkers to FDA entries via biomarker.biomarker_id = biomarker_fda.id (if biomarker_id stores biomarker_fda.id)
biomarker_linked_to_disease AS (
  SELECT
    br.id AS biomarker_internal_id,
    br.gene_symbol,
    br.biomarker_description,
    bt.doid::bigint AS disease_id
  FROM biomarker_row br
  JOIN biomarker_fda_tests_w_doid bt
    ON br.biomarker_id IS NOT NULL
    AND br.biomarker_id = bt.biomarker_fda_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM disease d
JOIN biomarker_linked_to_disease b
  ON b.disease_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol
